before.text: In Planning Parameters (cprpd0100m000), Planning ➔ Parameters ➔ Planning, master and order planning are implemented, with Online Update Resource Master Plan ticked. The work center has a calendar in Work Centers (tirou0101m000), Manufacturing ➔ Job Shop ➔ Shop Layout ➔ Work Centers, whose hours are in Calendar Working Hours (tcccp0120m000), Common ➔ Calendars ➔ Calendar Working Hours ➔ Calendar Working Hours, and its machines in Machine Capacity Groups (tirou4161m000), Manufacturing ➔ Job Shop ➔ Shop Layout ➔ Machine Capacity Groups. Work Centers - Planning (cprpd2100m000), Planning ➔ Master Data ➔ Items ➔ Work Centers - Planning, sets how many machines and people are available.

tokens.v: Each routing operation needs hours on its work center: its cycle time times the order quantity. Planning adds those hours up per period and sets them against the hours the work center has, which come from its calendar times its machines or people. Free capacity is what is left; a negative figure means the work center is overloaded in that period.
